name: fk-toolkit
description: Deterministic, provenance-audited Claude Code plugins: GitHub workflow automation, writing tools, narrated Manim video, engineering subagents, and the toolkit's own updater.

plugins.name: fk-eng-agents
plugins.description: Four focused subagents — researcher, planner, code-reviewer, debugger — for deep codebase research, dependency-aware planning, pre-commit review, and root-cause debugging. Adds no skill-listing context cost.

plugins.name: fk-gh-flow
plugins.description: End-to-end GitHub workflow: find issues worth working on, solve one into a pull request, follow up on review feedback, and write comments that read like a human wrote them.

plugins.name: fk-manim-video
plugins.description: Build Manim animations with synced spoken narration using edge-tts and ffmpeg. Ships a NarratedScene base class, reusable visuals, and a screenshot-asset pipeline.

plugins.name: fk-toolkit-ops
plugins.description: Operate the toolkit itself: check for and apply toolkit updates on the stable or edge channel, and wire an MCP server into Claude Code from a pasted config block.

plugins.name: fk-writing-kit
plugins.description: Turn raw material into publishable writing: strip AI tells from drafts, and build blog posts or LinkedIn copy from a chat, a URL, or a GitHub profile.
